title: Notice of unpaid debt
paragraphs: To the new owner of the herb shop,
We write about the loan your parent signed with this guild. We understand your parent left on an expedition and has not come back. Under town law, the shop is now yours, and so is everything it owes.
The balance stands at {DEBT_START} gold. Interest of {DEBT_INTEREST_RATE%} is added at the close of every month.
You will pay no less than {DEBT_MIN_PAYMENT} gold at each month end. If you pay less, a late fee of {HIDDEN_FEE_LATE} gold goes onto the balance. We do not give extensions.
In two months, a clerk will call on you to read your books. We suggest you keep them in order.
_doc: Opening letter. Tone: cold and strict (user decision 8 Nov 2026). {KEY} shows a BalanceConfig number, {KEY%} shows it as a percent.
